description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the 'advise_if_enabled' functionality within a Git testing environment. It sets up various scenarios to verify that advice messages are properly displayed or suppressed based on configuration variables and environment variables.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success under certain conditions.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after a test completes.

methods.name: test_tool advise
methods.description: Invokes the advice function in the test utility with a message.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or checks Git configuration variables for testing.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty.
